_comment: Download size budgets in bytes (docs/QUALITY_GATES.md G2, #179). Raising one needs a decision in the pull request. Sizes 2026-11-28: 10.8-15.4 MB.

workloads._comment: Large-file workloads (#206, scripts/bench/workloads.py --check). Each value bounds the median over the runs (ms or MiB; ui_ms_p95 and frame_ms_p95 are each run's per-frame p95). About 3x the Apple M5 medians of 2026-11-28 (bench/results/2026-11-28-workloads-macos.json), rounded up; per-frame app time at most one 60 Hz frame (16 ms); frame_ms includes painting, which CI runners do in software. CI runs the --quick set (log-200mb, find-50mb, 100 typed characters and scroll steps). Raising one needs a decision in the pull request.

workloads_by_os._comment: Replaces single limits above on one platform. GitHub's Windows runners paint with Direct3D's software adapter (WARP) at about 200 ms per frame, and finishing a find or log filter is noticed on the next frame, so those times are frame-bound there; their CPU is also about 3x slower than an M5 (typing app time 15 ms). About 3x the Windows CI medians of 2026-11-28 (PR #208).
